note: Style Options is an API to declare reusable style controls (plugin type style_option: css_class, background_color, background_image, property) in [ext].style_options.yml files and expose them on Layout Builder layouts and Paragraph types. Layouts must extend StyleOptionLayoutPlugin; Paragraphs use the 'style_options' Paragraphs behavior plugin, enabled per type -> paragraphs.paragraphs_type.<type>.behavior_plugins.style_options.enabled: true. No admin settings page (only the Option Plugin migrate form). Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real paragraphs behavior config (namespaced paragraph types so_*).

evals.prompt: What style-option plugins does the style_options module ship out of the box?
evals.expected_output: It ships four style_option plugins: css_class (attach CSS classes), background_color (a Spectrum color picker), background_image (background image), and a generic 'property'.

evals.prompt: How do you define which style options exist and where they appear in the style_options module? What is the config file naming convention?
evals.expected_output: Create a file named [module_or_theme_name].style_options.yml at the root of a module/theme. It has an 'options' section (each entry picks a plugin and its config) and a 'contexts' section that maps options onto 'layout' plugins and 'paragraphs' types (with _defaults, per-plugin overrides, and _disable).

evals.prompt: In style_options, what is the plugin type for a style control, and how would I add a custom one?
evals.expected_output: The plugin type is style_option (manager plugin.manager.style_options, dir src/Plugin/StyleOption, annotation @StyleOption). Add a class under src/Plugin/StyleOption with an @StyleOption(id=...) annotation extending StyleOptionPluginBase, then reference its id from a [ext].style_options.yml option's 'plugin' key.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which paragraph type has the Style Options behavior enabled? Inspect the live paragraph type configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The paragraph type so_known has the Style Options behavior enabled: paragraphs.paragraphs_type.so_known behavior_plugins.style_options.enabled is true.

evals.prompt: This site has two paragraph types, so_on and so_off. Exactly one has the Style Options behavior enabled. Inspect the live configuration and state which one.
evals.expected_output: so_on has Style Options enabled (paragraphs.paragraphs_type.so_on behavior_plugins.style_options.enabled = true); so_off does not.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a paragraph type so_task that does not yet have Style Options. Enable the Style Options paragraph behavior on it so editors get the style controls. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: paragraphs.paragraphs_type.so_task has behavior_plugins.style_options.enabled = true (e.g. via Structure > Paragraph types > so_task > Behaviors, or by enabling the style_options behavior plugin on the paragraph type in code).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new paragraph type with machine id so_build and enable the Style Options behavior on it. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A paragraph type paragraphs.paragraphs_type.so_build exists with behavior_plugins.style_options.enabled = true.
